fields.writeup: A lending-rate comparison dashboard for SME borrowers: pulls our hand-collected rate sheet of 14 NBFCs, filters by ticket size and tenure, and ranks effective APR including processing fees. Lead form writes to a sheet our anchor company's sales team already uses. Tested the APR math against two published examples and a hand calculation.

note: strong: real users, verified math, industry-specific

fields.writeup: Cold-chain audit checklist app for warehouse walkthroughs: 32-point checklist with photo notes, generates a scored PDF report per site. Built for our partner company's ops lead, who ran it on one real site visit and asked for two changes we shipped the same week.

note: strong: real site visit, iteration evidence

fields.writeup: Menu margin calculator for cafés: enter dish ingredients and costs, get margin per dish and a ranking. Works end to end with sample data; we haven't tested with a real café's numbers yet.
Lead-capture landing page for a connected-fitness studio with a class-schedule browser and a WhatsApp CTA. The schedule is hardcoded for now; form submissions land in a Google Sheet.

note: mid: functional but shallow, hardcoded data

fields.writeup: An app for my industry. It has a homepage and an about page. More features coming.

Expiry-date tracker for an e-pharmacy: upload a CSV of batches, see items expiring in 30/60/90 days with a discount suggestion. CSV parsing breaks on one of our three test files (comma in product name), documented in the README.

note: mid: useful, one honest known bug

fields.writeup: A quiz app made from the Lovable template. Changed the colors and the title to match our sector.

note: weak: template reskin, no industry substance

fields.writeup: Rooftop solar quote estimator: address + monthly bill in, system size, payback period and subsidy estimate out, using MNRE benchmark costs we cross-checked against two installer quotes. Includes a disclaimer page and an inquiry form wired to the team's shared inbox.
Price comparison dashboard for our anchor company's category with a lead-capture form wired to a sheet. Compares three competitor sites daily.
